$comment: AskCarnivore index — hand-curated, git-versioned. This is the whole product.
Shape (the one the Scan Layer will emit): topic aliases live ONCE on the
topic; `videos` is the flat list. While `status` is "PLACEHOLDER" the bot
shows a warning banner; "CURATED" means every url below is a real, verified
source. Content and status change in the SAME commit — never separately.
Fields:
id        stable slug, referenced by the model. NEVER reuse an id for a
different video — the worker resolves links from this file.
topic     canonical topic key, lowercase-kebab; must exist in `topics`.
type      conceptual | testimonial | practical
creator   display name, exactly as the creator writes it.
register  start | deep  (§14.4) — shorter way in vs fuller treatment.
lang      en | el — the language spoken in the video, not of the title.
title     the video's own title. Not our words.
url       verified watch URL. The model never sees this field.
duration  mm:ss — the basis the register is meant to follow (§14.4).
label     OUR framing of the link (§8); null = the model writes it under
the link-label rules.
Every url is checked against YouTube before it lands here, and the uploader
must be the creator's own channel: a clip or re-upload channel sends the
traffic to the wrong person and rots sooner (§6).
Rules that outlive this file: link-out only, never rehost, never transcripts.
Labels are experience/position, never a treatment claim.
note: Seed index — 2 θέματα, χειροκίνητο. Register tags = Nick's manual (υπερισχύουν της διάρκειας).
